title: Seq-Well
scope: Gierahn 2017 Seq-Well implementation as depicted; exclude later S3 refinements. Only the Seq-Well row of the supplied poster crop is extracted. The neighboring Act-Seq and Microwell-seq rows are context. The scope runs from cell suspension and capture beads through membrane-covered well lysis/capture to the physical barcoded cDNA library; sequencing and analysis are outside the depicted endpoint.

operations.label: Co-confine capture beads with cells and seal the wells
operations.description: Barcoded oligobeads are added to the cell-containing wells, and a semi-permeable membrane seals the array. The resulting preparation contains cells and beads within membrane-covered compartments.
operations.mechanism: The semi-permeable membrane permits exchange of lysis solutions while retaining macromolecules. Cell-first loading follows this schematic and is explicitly reported for PBMC arrays in the 2017 paper.
operations.information_effect: Co-confinement establishes the local cell-to-bead interface. The common barcode on one bead can subsequently associate captured RNA with that compartment.

operations.label: Recover captured-RNA beads and prepare a barcoded cDNA library
operations.description: The diagram groups the magnet/recovery and captured-mRNA preparation region before the cDNA-library endpoint. The 2017 paper resolves this interface as membrane peeling and bead removal, followed by bulk reverse transcription, amplification and library preparation. These actions remain one preparation block at the schematic’s resolution.
operations.mechanism: Bulk reverse transcription copies captured mRNA to cDNA; amplification and library preparation produce the barcoded DNA endpoint. The source does not break this block into a complete reaction sequence.
operations.information_effect: The sequenced carrier would be cDNA, representing captured cellular poly(A) transcripts. Cell barcodes support grouping by capture compartment, and UMIs support molecule-level interpretation among amplified products. The supplied drawing ends at a library and contains no sequencing-data or counting operation.
